tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL during internship at Sunflower Trip, taken live for real customer bookings.
Developed a full-stack trading platform (Zenvest) across three services using the MERN stack, featuring JWT-based authentication with httpOnly cookies and server-side request validation using Joi.
Created DriftGuard, a MERN-stack security control drift detection tool during a hackathon, deploying the full stack end-to-end across Vercel, Render, and MongoDB Atlas.
Developed StaySphere, an Airbnb-style property rental platform using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and EJS with complete listing CRUD, Cloudinary-backed image uploads, and Passport.js authentication.
kit.cover_letter: I am writing to apply for the MERN Developer - Intern role at Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies. As an MCA student at PES University with practical full-stack experience across the MERN stack, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready management system using Node.js, Express, Angular, and MySQL that went live for real customer bookings. Furthermore, through projects like Zenvest and StaySphere, I have hands-on experience building full-stack applications using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, implementing secure authentication, and handling database operations. I am comfortable working with the MERN stack and looking forward to the opportunity to contribute effectively during the 6-month internship and transition into a full-time role. Thank you for your time and consideration.
